# empty-node-project — Agent documentation (llms.txt)

> Generated by genetic-ai-starter `generate-llms-txt.mjs`. Curated navigation for LLM agents.

## Read order

1. `docs/ai/AI_NAVIGATION_MAP.md` — tier registry
2. Local `AI_INDEX.md` beside the subsystem you touch
3. `philosophy/genes/` — genetic tags (intent, not full prose)

## Philosophy genes (summary)

- `foundation.absolute_optimization.gen1` — philosophy/genes/foundation.absolute_optimization.gen1.md
- `foundation.ai_gene_interface.gen1` — philosophy/genes/foundation.ai_gene_interface.gen1.md
- `foundation.core_pillars.gen1` — **Product-engineering pillars** — the *judgment layer* behind every `.gen1` domain gene. Compression maps (Clusters A–M) answer *where files live*; pillars answer *whether the change is allowed*.

> **Compression warning:** After the 2026 gene wave, many `GENE_*_GEN2.md` files became **redirect stubs** (tag preserved, body moved). Stubs are **not** empty philosophy — they point at umbrellas. If a principle reads like a one-line bullet in PHILOSOPHY_INDEX, open the **pillar gene** below or the **long-form** doc in the right column.
- `foundation.creation_over_conflict.gen1` — philosophy/genes/foundation.creation_over_conflict.gen1.md
- `foundation.decomposition_reassembly.gen1` — philosophy/genes/foundation.decomposition_reassembly.gen1.md
- `foundation.elegant_minimalism.gen1` — philosophy/genes/foundation.elegant_minimalism.gen1.md
- `foundation.genetic_coding.gen1` — philosophy/genes/foundation.genetic_coding.gen1.md
- `foundation.time_decomposition.gen1` — philosophy/genes/foundation.time_decomposition.gen1.md
- `frontend.spa.ui_surface_registry.gen1` — philosophy/genes/frontend.spa.ui_surface_registry.gen1.md
- `repo.community.starter_spirit.gen1` — philosophy/genes/repo.community.starter_spirit.gen1.md
- `repo.engineering.adr.gen1` — **Architecture Decision Records** capture *why* — genes and indexes capture *how to navigate*. One ADR per significant decision.
- `repo.engineering.controlled_changes.gen1` — Changing the tree is part of the product. This gene defines **how** edits should be made so diffs stay **reviewable, reproducible, and safe** — especially when an AI applies them.

**Paired contract (Lance + AI):** founder sessions **ship final** in a **single** code path — no default dual-path rollout. See **`repo.engineering.founder_direct_ship.gen1`** ([repo.engineering.founder_direct_ship.gen1.md](repo.engineering.founder_direct_ship.gen1.md)).
- `repo.engineering.dna_protein_data_plane.gen1` — One **uniform** way to mutate and read 8DNA JSONB so we:

- do **not** overwrite whole `data` documents for single-leaf changes;
- preserve concurrent **`__protein_ops`** (durable DiffOp cells);
- stay under **`MAX_INLINE_JSONB_BYTES`** on fat tenants (INC-FAT-01, e.g. Unity pid 1444);
- reuse PathAtom / protein flush / leaf helpers instead of new RMW loops.

Pairs with **`repo.engineering.controlled_changes.gen1`** (how to edit *code*) and **`core.protein.merging.gen1`** (PathAtom / fusion semantics).
- `repo.engineering.founder_direct_ship.gen1` — Lance **does not use a personal canary loop** when building with the AI: work is **shipped as final** — one authoritative code path, **no** default parallel “old path + gated new path” invented for a founder session. That avoids **duplicated logic**, confusing branches, and half-dead toggles the model must keep in sync.

The **platform still implements** canary, percent buckets, and 8DNA sandbox for **tenants and ops**; this gene only constrains **what the assistant assumes** in **this** collaboration.
- `repo.engineering.testing.gen1` — philosophy/genes/repo.engineering.testing.gen1.md
- `repo.evolution.compression.gen1` — **Gene compression map** reduces cognitive surface: one contour = one reading order. Physical files stay separate; agents read **clusters**, not every gene.
- `repo.navigation.index.gen1` — Owns **`AI_INDEX.md`** files: hot files, sideways links, parent link, genetic code header, **Remarks**.
- `repo.navigation.map.gen1` — Owns the contract for **`docs/ai/AI_NAVIGATION_MAP.md`**: Tier 0 (package roots) and Tier 1 (large subsystems).
- `repo.platform.capability_contract.gen1` — **Drift contract** between four discoverability planes that must stay aligned for integrators, plugins, recipes, and AI agents:

1. **`sdk.getCapabilityMatrix()`** — client-side module enablement (`platform` + `domain` ids, `enabled` flags).
2. **`GET /mcp/actions`** — authoritative MCP action catalogue (canonical dotted `action` ids).
3. **`@agentstack/sdk` package exports** — `package.json` `exports` map and subpath facades (`/commerce/*`, `/economy`, `/manifest`, …).
4. **Kit docs** — `CONTEXT_FOR_AI.md`, `capability-snapshot.json`, recipe `gateCapability` tables, plugin skills linking to `CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md`.

**Acceptance target (DX expansion):** capability contract drift **0** — see `genetic-ai-starter/benchmarks/results/BASELINE_PRE_DX_EXPANSION.md`.
- `repo.platform.sdk.onboarding.gen1` — Canonical **develop-on-AgentStack** onboarding path for integrators and AI agents: from zero in a consumer repo to authenticated, project-scoped calls on the correct channel (SDK protocol plane, not ad hoc `fetch`).

**North star:** discover before execute; gate optional modules; prefer typed SDK surfaces over raw HTTP.
- `repo.platform.sdk.recipes.gen1` — Index and maintenance contract for **runnable TypeScript recipes 00–11** under `genetic-ai-starter/extensions/agentstack/recipes/`. Each recipe is a minimal, verifiable integrator script (`run.ts` + README pair) that teaches one SDK/MCP/8DNA surface without importing the whole monorepo.

Recipes are **kit subtree artifacts** — not copied to consumer installs; run from the vendored kit path or clone.
- `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.agentstack_dx.gen1` — Umbrella for the **AgentStack Starter DX expansion** — everything that helps integrators and AI agents go from kit install to a correct first SDK/MCP/8DNA call without reading the whole monorepo. Covers the **`agentstack` kit extension**, runnable recipes, gene scaffolder, benchmark evals, MCP config template, and devcontainer bootstrap.

This gene sits **above** `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.gen1` (Navigation OS) and **beside** `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.integration.gen1` (transport). Read integration first for submodule/install; read this gene for **develop-on-AgentStack** surfaces.
- `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.agent_floor.gen1` — Raise the **engineering floor** for cheap or weak agents via Navigation OS rails in git (map, genes, doctor) — not “turn mini models into Opus.”
- `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.benchmark.gen1` — philosophy/genes/repo.tooling.genetic_starter.benchmark.gen1.md
- `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.docs.gen1` — Index of **kit meta documentation** (`genetic-ai-starter/meta/docs/`) — not copied to consumer installs. Use **upstream URLs** below when working from an installed project.
- `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.gen1` — Canonical pointer to the **Genetic AI Starter Kit** — portable **Navigation OS**: genetic tags → `AI_NAVIGATION_MAP` → `AI_INDEX.md` → philosophy genes → Cursor rules → doctor/lock.
- `repo.tooling.genetic_starter.integration.gen1` — philosophy/genes/repo.tooling.genetic_starter.integration.gen1.md
- `repo.tooling.gene_lifecycle.gen1` — Lifecycle policy for **philosophy genes** in the Genetic AI Starter Kit and Fixture App: when to create `gen1`, when to bump to `gen2`, how **DEPRECATED / redirect** stubs work, and how **`validate-genes.mjs`** enforces minimum structure on kit-shipped payload genes.
